why: Refining data seen in the in-game Reprocessing Plant window (right-click an ore > Reprocess). per_unit = minerals you get per ONE unit of ore at the yield you had when you looked (yield_seen). If your refining yield changes (skills, station), update yield_seen and run the window again.
